events.title: Elevated authentication failure ratio
events.detail: Failure ratio on /v1/auth/token rose above the 20% baseline from a single source (185.220.101.47).

events.title: Distributed failure pattern
events.detail: Failures now spread across 6 source addresses in 6 countries, each below the per-IP threshold.

events.title: Rate-limit rule engaged
events.detail: Rule auth-burst-v3 began rejecting requests to /v1/auth/token above 30/min per source.

events.title: Credential stuffing confirmed
events.detail: Attempt rate peaked at 334/min. Reused credential pairs matched a known breach corpus.

events.title: Valid credentials accepted
events.detail: billing-svc@northwind.example authenticated successfully from a flagged source; the account is not enrolled in MFA.

events.title: Source ranges blocked
events.detail: All 6 attributed ranges added to the edge deny list.

events.title: Campaign contained
events.detail: Attempt rate returned to baseline. One session revoked, one password reset enforced.
